method: Independent model cross-review of every unchanged proposed source record/POS/sense/frame/profile/context in the 39-root batch. Each approval confirms the exact new selected Spanish dictionary meaning rendered in original model English; different prior selections remain archival, not automatic authority or blended context. These are word-level lexical or grammatical fragments, not complete examples, dictionary-provided English, native-human certification or actual form-coverage counts. Every selected source record and zero-based sense was checked; contexts preserve regional, archaic, technical and subject restrictions. Only the explicit aspect subset is approved. No inferred mandatory clitic, changed profile, guessed English irregular form, new source scope or fabricated noun/object is authorized. Number-sensitive function words were assessed separately from English-invariant adjectives and possessives.
